newsitem.title: USA: BellSouth CFO backs 1997 year EPS forecast.
newsitem.headline: BellSouth CFO backs 1997 year EPS forecast.

text.p: BellSouth Corp's chief financial officer said Monday he is comfortable meeting Wall Street's 1997 earnings expectations of $2.80 per share.
"I'm not at all uncomfortable with that," Ronald Dykes told Reuters in an interview.
Dykes expressed confidence in the Baby Bell company's ability to meet expectations even though doing so "implies double-digit growth for the rest of the year."
Dykes said he was particularly optimistic about growth prospects for the company's international cellular division and for the installation of additional access lines in residential customers' homes.
